flow-definition.description: Run a performance test script in Docker, stream metrics to InfluxDB, and archive one artifact bundle.

org.biouno.unochoice.ChoiceParameter.name: PROJECT
org.biouno.unochoice.ChoiceParameter.description: Project folder from perf_scripts that contains at least one supported script.

secureScript.script: def branch = binding.variables.get('SCRIPT_BRANCH') ?: 'main' def output = ['/var/jenkins_home/scripts/performance-choices.sh', 'projects', branch].execute().text def choices = output.readLines().collect { it.trim() }.findAll { it } return choices ?: ['forte']

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SCRIPT_BRANCH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git branch for the performance scripts repository.

org.biouno.unochoice.CascadeChoiceParame.name: TOOL
org.biouno.unochoice.CascadeChoiceParame.description: Detected from script files inside the selected project. If only one tool exists, this field has one option.

secureScript.script: def project = binding.variables.get('PROJECT') ?: 'forte' def branch = binding.variables.get('SCRIPT_BRANCH') ?: 'main' def output = ['/var/jenkins_home/scripts/performance-choices.sh', 'tools', branch, project].execute().text def choices = output.readLines().collect { it.trim() }.findAll { it } return choices ?: ['k6']

org.biouno.unochoice.CascadeChoiceParame.name: SCRIPT_PATH
org.biouno.unochoice.CascadeChoiceParame.description: Detected script path inside the selected project for the selected tool.

secureScript.script: def project = binding.variables.get('PROJECT') ?: 'forte' def branch = binding.variables.get('SCRIPT_BRANCH') ?: 'main' def tool = binding.variables.get('TOOL') ?: 'k6' def output = ['/var/jenkins_home/scripts/performance-choices.sh', 'scripts', branch, project, tool].execute().text def choices = output.readLines().collect { it.trim() }.findAll { it } return choices ?: ['perf_scripts/forte/k6/smoke.js']

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SCENARIO
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Scenario tag saved to InfluxDB and artifacts.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: DESCRIPTION
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Short human-readable note saved in artifacts and InfluxDB tag runDescription.
